import re
xml = open('unpacked/word/document.xml', encoding='utf-8').read()
print('LENGTH', len(xml))
# Find all paragraphs, show style and text
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>', xml, re.S)
print('NUM PARAS', len(paras))
for i,p in enumerate(paras):
    style = re.search(r'<w:pStyle w:val="([^"]+)"', p)
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p)
    style = style.group(1) if style else 'DEFAULT'
    txt = ''.join(texts)
    print(i, '|', style, '|', txt)
